title: Order XIV Rule 1 — Framing of issues — CPC 1908

content.heading: Framing of issues
content.text: Issues arise when a material proposition of fact or law is affirmed by the one party and denied by the other. Material propositions are those propositions of law or fact which a plaintiff must allege in order to show a right to sue or a defendant must allege in order to constitute his defence. Each material proposition affirmed by one party and denied by the other shall form the subject of a distinct issue.
